editorial_notes: All mathematical statement and proof text is reproduced verbatim from chapter7.tex of the pinned checkout github.com/wenweili/AlJabr-2 at commit e03224e2e867a49dc60c7975d890079068a30466. The file is packaging: it adds no mathematics and rewrites no author text.

Packaging changes, each forced by the pinned TeX Live 2025 and each checked before writing: the author's class needs ctex, xeCJK, zhnumber and ntheorem, which are not installed, so the Chinese text is set with the Noto Serif / Noto Sans CJK SC faces that are installed -- the same treatment the three pre-existing AlJabr-2 deliveries in this corpus use; the author's own printed numbers are restored from a per-task fragment; the index commands are no-ops.

The counted span keeps the author's cross-references to results outside it. Those results are the author's earlier results in the same pinned commit; they are pointed at and not reproduced, and no prerequisite is re-derived here.

Isolated visual overlay: only the two original six-strand braids inside the one source center are rendered from retained author-PDF page449 vector clips. The original pinned statement/proof tokens and literal equality remain unchanged; the original braids syntax is not executed. The whole author PDF build-to-commit relationship is unestablished; the root explicitly accepted this locally matched figure as an asset only. This sample is not READY or publication approval.
